details: The Liquid Network has successfully recovered 3,400 BTC following a bridge exploit, with details suggesting a "white-hat" intervention. This recovery effort has largely neutralized the initial negative impact of the funds drain, bringing a positive resolution to the incident.
title: Liquid Network Recovers 3,400 BTC After Exploit

details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) attracted almost $1 billion in inflows recently, while Ethereum funds continued their positive streak of capital accumulation. This trend indicates sustained and robust institutional demand for major cryptocurrencies, supporting their long-term market presence.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Nearly $1B Inflows, Ethereum Funds Maintain Streak

details: Bitcoin's price dropped below $80,000 on Monday, influenced by strong US employment data that heightened expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike. Despite this macroeconomic pressure, crypto-focused ETFs demonstrated strong institutional demand, recording $1.25 billion in inflows last week.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $80K Amid Rate Hike Fears, ETF Inflows Persist

details: Ethereum is targeting the implementation of quantum-resistant capabilities for its Layer 1 blockchain by 2029. This strategic development aims to address future security vulnerabilities posed by quantum computing, significantly enhancing the network's long-term resilience and security.
title: Ethereum Aims for Quantum-Resistant Layer 1 by 2029
